name: XDKNet 2.5.10
body:
Android TV 2.5.10, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.9 (Emby 2.0.5.9).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

## For everyone

- **Where to watch on the Classic title page.** The "Also on" line with the
  streaming services a title is on now shows on the Classic page too, under
  the ratings. On a TV, press Up from Play to reach it.

## For admins: Radarr and Sonarr (Jellyfin)

- **Clear failed imports.** Downloads that finished but couldn't be imported
  keep using space in the download client. The Requests page now shows how
  many there are and how much space they use, and removes them with their
  files from the download client, blocklists the release and searches
  again, one at a time or all at once.
- **Clear them automatically**, off by default: under the Requests page's
  Automatic clean-up, or Plugins > XDKNet > Radarr and Sonarr > Failed
  imports. Failed downloads are cleared after 24 hours (you can change it)
  and searched for again.
- **Replace a file.** A title page's Admin controls now offer **Replace
  file** when Radarr or Sonarr has the title on disk: pick the file or
  episodes, confirm with the size shown, and then search again or pick a
  release yourself. The same is in the Requests page's title details under
  Files on disk.
- **Act on many requests at once.** Select titles on the Requests page (on a
  TV, press Select first), or "Select all that need attention", then search
  them all, remove their failed downloads, or go through interactive search
  for each one in turn with Skip and Next.

Every removal and deletion asks first, shows the size, and is written to
the XDKNet plugin log with who did it.

Pair with plugin 2.1.0.9 (Emby 2.0.5.9).
